title: Knowledge Check 4: Lessons 16–20
description: Pooled check over Lessons 16–20 of the Salesforce Architect series. Score 80% or higher to unlock the cert prep exam.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Data Migration Strategy: ETL vs ELT, Tools, Validation, Cutover, and Rollback”, what is the central focus?
options: The full migration lifecycle: ETL vs ELT, the Salesforce tool options (Data Import Wizard vs Data Loader vs enterprise ETL), dependency-ordered loading with external IDs, validation by record count and spot check, and the cutover and rollback plan that keeps a bad load from becoming a disaster.
A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: The full migration lifecycle: ETL vs ELT, the Salesforce tool options (Data Import Wizard vs Data Loader vs enterprise ETL), dependency-ordered loading with external IDs, validation by record count and spot check, and the cutover and rollback plan that keeps a bad load from becoming a disaster.

A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: Where work happens and how it moves to production.
